purpose: Coverage-oriented extraction pilot; not a representative estimate of error rates.
selection_inputs: Original training query text only; no gold annotations or model outcomes.

strata_in_priority_order.name: promotion
strata_in_priority_order.query_regex: 买[0-9一二三四五六七八九十两]+.{0,8}(?:送|赠)[0-9一二三四五六七八九十两]+

strata_in_priority_order.name: purchase_conditions
strata_in_priority_order.query_regex: 定金|尾款|每米|每平|加工费|工费|运费|顺丰|保修|质保|商家|店铺|旗舰店|专营店|大药房

strata_in_priority_order.name: bundle_components
strata_in_priority_order.query_regex: 套餐|套装|组合装|附赠|附带|赠送

strata_in_priority_order.name: quantity
strata_in_priority_order.query_regex: [0-9一二三四五六七八九十两]+(?:瓶|包|盒|支|个|件|对|片|组)

strata_in_priority_order.name: budget_complex
strata_in_priority_order.query_regex: 上下|左右|[一二三四五六七八九十两百千万]+元|[0-9]+\s*[-~～至到]\s*[0-9]+|至少|不低于

strata_in_priority_order.name: specifications
strata_in_priority_order.query_regex: 厘米|毫米|尺寸|尺码|[0-9]+码|[0-9]+(?:cm|mm|kg|ml|寸|斤|克|米)|材质|兼容|适配|[0-9]+孔

strata_in_priority_order.name: preferences
strata_in_priority_order.query_regex: 最好|优先|尽量|偏好|喜欢|希望

heldout_boundary: Dev/Final task_id read only to assert disjointness; no heldout questions used.
